pharaoh_piledriver: Spoken word over Ethio-jazz funk. Androgynous mid-range narrator voice, warm and dry, carnival-barker charm, close-mic. Vibraphone, wah guitar, upright bass, tight breakbeat drums, darbuka, baritone sax stabs. 104 bpm. Every line spoken, never sung; long pauses between lines, the band breathes in the gaps. No chorus, no rhyme, no singing.
epistemic_sabotage: Spoken word, beat-poetry delivery in a smoky jazz club. Androgynous calm voice, dry wit, intimate close-mic. Walking upright bass, brushed snare, muted trumpet, Rhodes piano, finger snaps. Medium swing 92 bpm. Deliberate pause after every line, sparse arrangement, short trumpet answers in the gaps. No singing, no chorus.
cosmic_grift_dark_journalism: Spoken word over 60s spy jazz and exotica lounge. Androgynous conspiratorial voice, half whisper, half news anchor. Twangy surf guitar, bongos, theremin, alto flute, vibraphone, walking bass, cinematic brass hits. 112 bpm. Sudden stops and pauses between lines, suspense in the gaps. Never sung, no chorus.
trust_and_betrayal: Spoken word over slow-burn neo-soul funk, tragicomic. Androgynous husky narrator, deadpan, a little wounded. Clavinet, fat electric bass, Rhodes, horn section swells, sparse drums with rimshots, organ pads. 84 bpm. Dramatic pauses between lines, the groove sits back. Never sung, no chorus, no rhyme.
alt_afrobeat: Spoken word over Afrobeat. Androgynous confident narrator voice, rhythmic but spoken. Interlocking guitars, shekere, congas, punchy horn riffs, deep bass, steady 110 bpm groove. Clear pauses between lines, horns answer in the gaps. No singing, no chorus.
alt_bossa: Spoken word over minimal bossa nova. Androgynous soft-spoken voice, amused and gentle. Nylon guitar, light brushes, upright bass, soft flute. 128 bpm bossa feel, very sparse. Long relaxed pauses between lines. No singing, no chorus.
alt_manouche: Spoken word over Gypsy jazz manouche. Androgynous storyteller voice, theatrical and wry. Rhythm guitar la pompe, lead violin, accordion, upright bass. 180 bpm swing, sudden stops for pauses between lines. Never sung, no chorus.
alt_jazzfunk_breaks: Spoken word over 70s jazz-funk breaks. Androgynous laid-back narrator voice, cool and dry. Fender Rhodes, clavinet, slap bass, open hi-hats, flute riffs, string stabs. 98 bpm. Breakdown pauses between lines, the beat drops out and returns. No singing, no chorus.
